explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration stating this base-change identity. Mathlib's `LinearMap.polyCharpolyAux_map_aeval` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Polynomial.lean) gives a characteristic-polynomial base-change identity, but does not itself identify the norm of the tensor-coordinate element with the evaluated constant coefficient. That requires additional results, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation from a single declaration.
